anime_multiverse.skill.adaptability.desc: Unique. Toggle. A skill that evolves through punishment: every kind of damage you survive is learned, so the next hit of that kind hurts less; Severance is adapted to completely, resistances are learned faster, and your skills slowly gain mastery.
anime_multiverse.skill.adolla_burst.desc: Ultimate. Evolved from Devil's Footprints. Move at the speed of light striking everything on the way, kick with far more force, and unleash the Adolla Burst around you.
anime_multiverse.skill.airiel.descriptio: Unique. Tempest: wrap yourself in wind for speed, power and protection from arrows, or ride it in a sudden dash that recovers faster while the wind blows.
anime_multiverse.skill.all_fiction.descr: Ultimate. Make injuries, enemies and even your own death never have happened.
anime_multiverse.skill.arcs_ray.descript: Chanted magic (1 line). A piercing beam of light strikes everything in a line, and burns the undead even harder.
anime_multiverse.skill.argonaut.descript: Unique. The wish to become a hero. Hold to charge with the chime of bells (up to five), release to strike everything in front of you.
anime_multiverse.skill.black_wings.descr: Ultimate. Toggle. Total reflection of melee and projectiles, no fall damage, and wings that let you glide in the air while you sneak.
anime_multiverse.skill.book_maker.descri: Unique. Pin your target with giant screws and drag it down to your level. Once mastered, Barrage pins every foe in front of you.
anime_multiverse.skill.chant.arcs_ray.1: Arcs Ray: pierce them, arrow of light.
anime_multiverse.skill.chant.futsunomita: Futsunomitama: press them to the earth.
anime_multiverse.skill.chant.rea_laevate: Flames of the dawn, rise from the ground.
Circle the one who calls you and burn all who approach.
Rea Laevateinn: let the pillars of fire arise.
anime_multiverse.skill.chant.uchide_no_k: Little mallet of fortune, hear my prayer.
Lend your strength to the one who stands before me.
Uchide no Kozuchi: grow, and rise above yourself.
anime_multiverse.skill.chant.wynn_fimbul: Winter's breath, come to my call.
Let the frozen sky fall and the world turn white.
Wynn Fimbulvetr: freeze everything that lives.
anime_multiverse.skill.devils_footprints: Unique. Flames burst from your feet: dash through the air or deliver a burning kick. Your own fire cannot hurt you.
anime_multiverse.skill.faith.description: Unique. Pray to gather Faith, then spend it to bestow a skill upon a player you look at. Faith is kept when this skill evolves.
anime_multiverse.skill.firebolt.descript: Instant magic. A bolt of lightning-fire fired the moment you press, striking what you look at and scorching everything near it. Mastery doubles the damage.
anime_multiverse.skill.freya.description: Unique. Goddess of Beauty. Your Charm makes nearby monsters forget you and leaves your enemies dazed.
anime_multiverse.skill.futsunomitama.des: Chanted magic (2 lines). A gravity field at the spot you look at crushes foes down, pulls them in and pins them.
anime_multiverse.skill.gate_of_babylon.d: Ultimate. The King of Heroes' vault from Fate in ten modes: Gate, Volley, Rain, Chains of Heaven, Golden Armour, Vimana, King's Aura, Gae Bolg, Ea and Elixir.
Ultimate. Evolved from Faith. Bestow for half the Faith and half the wait, pray for triple Faith, grant allies a Blessing, and work a Miracle that heals and protects them.
anime_multiverse.skill.hati.description: Unique. Passive. Fire, lightning and magic hitting you are partly absorbed and turned into stacking Strength.
anime_multiverse.skill.hawk_eye.descript: Toggle. Bird Card sight: night vision, and every hostile creature around you glows, even through walls.
anime_multiverse.skill.hell_conqueror.de: Ultimate. Toggle. Evolved from Hell Walker. Near death your blows become devastating and heal you, and a hellfire aura burns the foes around you.
anime_multiverse.skill.hell_walker.descr: Unique. Toggle. The closer you are to death, the harder you hit: at ten percent health your blows deal about double.
anime_multiverse.skill.hephaestus.descri: Unique. Goddess of the Forge. Restore the weapon in your hand, and your off-hand and armour once mastered.
anime_multiverse.skill.heros_argonaut.de: Ultimate. Evolved from Argonaut. Charge up to ten bells and strike with triple power, or release the charge as a piercing Hero's Beam.
anime_multiverse.skill.hestia.descriptio: Unique. Goddess of the Hearth. Heal and bless yourself and every ally around you; once mastered it also cleanses and wards off fire.
anime_multiverse.skill.immortal_will.des: Ultimate. Evolved from Unbreakable Will. Rise from a killing blow at full health, far more often, with a shockwave; Rally heals and cleanses you on demand.
anime_multiverse.skill.ki.description: Ultimate. Dragon Ball's ki in ten modes: Ki Blast, Kamehameha, Instant Transmission, Solar Flare, Afterimage, Super Saiyan, Spirit Bomb, Kaioken, Ultra Instinct and Ki Sense.
anime_multiverse.skill.liaris_freese.des: Unique. Passive. While your feelings remain, so does your growth: your kills can raise the mastery of all your skills.
anime_multiverse.skill.loki.description: Unique. The Trickster. Vanish from sight and blink forward; monsters that were hunting you lose track of you.
anime_multiverse.skill.lord_of_gluttonou: Ultimate. The skill of the Black Sword Greed: devour what you kill (stats, satiation, skills into the Gluttony Vault). Modes: Secret Technique (pays a share of the devoured stats for the technique of the form in hand), Half-Starvation (double devouring, faster hunger), Offer (a tenth of your magicule for stored EP and satiation).
anime_multiverse.skill.lord_of_summons.d: Ultimate. Evolved from Summoner. Twice the summons and far stronger cards: Beast Card calls three wolves, Stone Card is a colossus, Legion calls a pack of five and the Wraith Card a swarm of flying spirits.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.almighty.cool: That future is not yet visible.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.beast.off: The Beast Will skills are switched off on this server.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.bookmaker.loc: Master Book Maker to unlock Barrage.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.db.off: The Dragon Ball skills are switched off on this server.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.db.rewound: The lethal blow is denied: you are rewound.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.evolution.con: Confirmed. %s's Unique Skill %s has evolved into the Ultimate Skill %s.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.evolution.nee: Your mastered %s wants to evolve, but your soul needs %s EP.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.faith.divine_: The goddess has not yet recovered.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.faith.has_all: %s already has every skill you can bestow.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.faith.miracle: A miracle: your allies are healed and protected.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.faith.no_targ: Look at a player to bestow.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.fiction.annul: Harm is made not to have happened.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.fiction.nulli: The next blow will never have happened.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.fiction.off: That part of All Fiction is switched off on this server.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.fiction.rewin: That place cannot be stood in now.
There is nowhere to rewind to yet.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.fiction.stand: Your death is ready to be made fiction.
Your death will be fiction again in %s seconds.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.gate.armor: The Golden Armour closes around you.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.gate.chains: The Chains of Heaven bind it.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.gate.off: The Gate of Babylon is switched off on this server.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.god.cooldown: This divine power is on cooldown.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.ki.afterimage: Afterimage: the next blow will find only an image.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.ki.off: Ki is switched off on this server.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.ki.ssj: Your hair turns gold: Super Saiyan!
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.ki.too_weak: You are too hurt for Kaioken.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.ki.ui: Ultra Instinct: your body moves on its own.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.liaris.status: Liaris Freese: your skills have grown %s times.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.magic.ready: The chant is complete: release to cast.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.milestone.1: %s is a quarter mastered: its reach grows.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.milestone.2: %s is half mastered: its main power gains a second effect.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.milestone.3: %s is three quarters mastered: it costs less and recharges faster.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.milestone.4: %s is mastered: its mastered form awakens.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.gyo: Gyo: the aura gathers in your eyes.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.in: In: your aura cannot be seen.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.ken: Ken: you hold your ground, and a third of every blow goes back at who struck.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.ko: Ko: all your aura gathers in one fist. Strike now, or wait: the longer, the harder.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.off: Nen is switched off on this server.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.ryu: Ryu: your aura flows to where it is needed.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.shu: Shu: your aura wraps what you hold.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.ten: Ten: your aura wraps your body.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.trans.ele: Transmutation: your aura turns to lightning.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.trans.gum: Transmutation: your aura turns to gum.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.trans.rub: Transmutation: your aura turns to rubber.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.vow: You swear the vow: no Ten, Zetsu or Ken, and your hatsu hit harder.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.nen.zetsu: Zetsu: your presence is gone and you rest. The blow that breaks it is an ambush.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.summoner.cap: You can only have %s summons at once.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.summoner.lord: Only the Lord of Summons can call this card.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.summoner.name: Beast Card
Legion Card
Stone Card
Wraith Card
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.will.recoveri: Your will is still recovering (%s s).
anime_multiverse.skill.nen.description: Ultimate. Hunter x Hunter's life energy in seventeen modes: Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Gyo, En, Ken, Ko, Shu, In, Ryu, the six Hatsu types (Enhancement, Transmutation, Emission, Conjuration, Manipulation, Specialization) and Vow and Limitation.
anime_multiverse.skill.rea_laevateinn.de: Chanted magic (3 lines). Wave after wave of flame pillars erupt around you and burn every foe that comes close.
anime_multiverse.skill.shishou.descripti: Ultimate. The talking sword's abilities as one skill: switch modes (Telekinesis, Sensory, Defence, Offence, Storage, Magic, Counsel) with the mode key, press the skill key to use the mode, sneak and press to pick the next ability of a mode. Hold him in your hand to cast; his own mana pays.
anime_multiverse.skill.spirit_card.descr: Toggle. A healing aura for you and everyone near you; once mastered it also cleanses harmful effects.
anime_multiverse.skill.summoner.descript: Unique. Call summon cards: a Beast Card wolf or a Stone Card golem fight beside you, Recall dismisses them. Mastery raises how many can answer.
anime_multiverse.skill.the_almighty.desc: Ultimate. See every future and choose the one where you are never harmed.
anime_multiverse.skill.the_visionary.des: Ultimate. Whatever you imagine becomes reality: a meteor, a void, a perfect body.
anime_multiverse.skill.uchide_no_kozuchi: Chanted magic (3 lines). Level Boost: greatly raise the power of the ally you look at, or your own, for a time.
Unique. Passive. Once in a long while, survive a killing blow and stand back up. Press to see whether your will is ready.
anime_multiverse.skill.wynn_fimbulvetr.d: Chanted magic (3 lines). A blizzard falls on the spot you look at: it freezes everything in it and keeps chilling whatever stays.
